snippet.title: As I Began to Dream | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
As I Began to Dream is a hand-drawn puzzle platformer detailing the story of a young girl’s journey through a mysterious dream world.

As you through the various, dreamlike realms, explore manifestations of her life and experiences, recover the bits and pieces of Lily’s memories, find out what led her to this mysterious limbo, and guide her to finding peace and acceptance.

As I Began to Dream launches 20th November on Steam, Epic Games, and Nintendo Switch consoles.
